name: hxFileManager
description: hxFileManager is a cross-platform file management library for Haxe with a clean async API backed by a native thread pool. Covers file read/write/append/prepend/truncate, safe atomic writes, raw bytes and Base64 I/O, JSON read/write/patch, folder create/copy/move/delete, recursive listing and deep search (by name, extension, or content), empty-folder cleanup, file and folder watchers, file metadata (size, mtime, MD5, SHA-256), file comparison, unique name generation, temp file/folder creation, batch operations (read, write, copy, move, delete), and HTTP downloads with retry and progress. HttpManager adds GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE, JSON requests, redirect following, status codes, response headers, internet detection, and retry logic.
